# GrantRead

`schemas/api/grant.json`

One record of GET /v1/grants (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants", "Read authorization"): a grant as issued, revoked ones included with when. Its project is every project it names (projects and listed read projects): one named project is that project's record; several, or every project, make it installation-wide, read only under an every-project read. Never the approval it was issued under, nor any credential.
